card.name: Drug names and how drugs are given
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the last piece of a split drug name (digoxin, methotrexate) or to a dosing word such as infusion, agent or complex. It appears in drug-label text about co-administration and administration.

modes.label: Split drug names
modes.description: Middle or end piece of a drug name such as digoxin or methotrexate.
modes.example: ORENCIA may be used as monotherapy or concomitantly with methotrex<<ate>>.

modes.label: Administration wording
modes.description: Words like infusion, be, or agent in directions on how to give a drug.
modes.example: Start the<< infusion>> after preparation is complete.

card.plain: It fires on the end of drug names like digoxin or methotrexate and on words describing how a drug is given.
